patches.value: Under L1, for all t in I the sum of the L^2 norms of P_(>N)C_[a,t](e,g,V)/3 and P_(>N)C_[a,t](v,v,e)/6 is <=C_M*h*tau^gamma+C_M*(h+N^(-pstar))*E_I.

Under L1, for every t in I, Fint(t)=[J_s(e,g)]_(s=a)^(s=t)/3-C_[a,t](e,g,V)/3-C_[a,t](v,v,e)/6+(1/3)integral_a^t J_s(mathcalR',V)ds. The L^2 norm of the projection P_(>N) of its two endpoint terms is <=C_M*N^(-1)*E_I.
Under L1, e(t)=e(a)+Fint(t)-(mathcalR(t)-mathcalR(a)) for t in I, and sup_(t in I)||P_(<=N)Fint(t)||_2<=C_M*N^2*h*E_I.
